qualification: Source-document conflict at the vertical SYN connector; pin 6 is the page-18 assembly/cable model choice, while the page-9 handwritten pin 7 annotation remains unexplained

page9.trace: SYN arrow enters the left side of R3 on page 9

reading_notes: Both 600 and 1200 dpi page-9 views read the handwritten left-edge marking as X3:7, adjacent to the printed SYN arrow; the 7 is not a diode or a test-point mark.
The page-18 .11 assembly drawing prints six numbered X3 positions, with SYN at 6, and its six-wire cable pairs main-board X4:6 to vertical-board X3:6.
The page-9 label may be an annotation for another connector/revision; the scan alone does not establish that history. The page-18 printed assembly pin 6 is the source for the modeled six-pin cable.
The service-observations waveform register currently attributes its X3:6 mapping to source page 9; that provenance is inaccurate and requires a separate receipt refresh before changing the register.
